text:
sam_support: Customer (acct: acme-inc) reports they get kicked to login immediately after password reset. Browser shows the session cookie still present but app prompts reauth.
priya_m: ticket #5562, just landed in my queue. Any recent auth changes?
alex_chan: We rolled a device-trust key rotation yesterday at 08:10 UTC for a KMS rekey. Could be related.
jenna_sre: Can you share the user's cookie header and the server-side auth logs (redact tokens)?
sam_support: Pasted minimal logs from the customer (redacted):
```
GET /apps/dashboard 200
Cookie: rwd_session=eyJhbGci...; rwd_device=dev_64f2...
AuthService: device-assertion failed: key-id mismatch, err=stale_device_key
SessionService: session valid but device not trusted -> force_reauth
```
They only see the UX reauth, not a 401.
priya_m: Repro steps from customer: password reset via email -> sign in on laptop -> redirected to /reauth even though cookie exists. Mobile app continues to work (token-based).
alex_chan: That aligns with device-trust flow: password reset should invalidate certain device attestations. But we expected a grace window while device keys propagate. Looks like grace window didn't cover rekey propagation to the auth edge.
jenna_sre: Quick check: did the rotation push new key IDs but not the fallback accept list? If old key wasn't accepted by edge, device assertions with old key will be rejected.
auth-bot: deploy:auth/rotate-device-key v2026.03.16 completed 2026-03-16T08:10Z. Fallback acceptance TTL=0 (config=0s) due to misconfig.
sam_support: So devices that authenticated recently were relying on old key and now get forced reauth. Customer unhappy because SSO flow does full MFA again.
priya_m: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) revert rotation or 2) re-enable fallback acceptance TTL to 5m, and 3) advise customer to clear device cookie to force fresh device enrollment (workaround). Which do we pick?
alex_chan: Revert is heavy. Re-enable fallback TTL to 5m and run targeted job to accept assertions signed by previous key for sessions created within last 24h. I'll prepare the patch.
jenna_sre: In parallel, we should surface a support note: instruct customer to clear `rwd_device` cookie or use incognito to complete reauth. Also document that mobile tokens unaffected.
sam_support: I told the customer to clear `rwd_device` cookie and re-login; they confirmed mobile ok but web still getting reauth loop for a subset of users.
priya_m: Rolling the TTL config now. Patch ID: auth-config#890. ETA 10m.
auth-bot: config:update auth/fallback_accept_ttl=300s by alex_chan — success
alex_chan: Pushed targeted acceptance job for old-key assertions for sessions created <24h. Monitoring logs for reduction in `stale_device_key` errors.
jenna_sre: Please capture a complaint example (session id) so we can verify it propagated.
sam_support: Customer sent session id s-9a8b7c. I forwarded.
priya_m: Follow-up: will keep ticket #5562 open until we confirm no further web reauth loops. We should add an incident postmortem note: missing fallback TTL in rotation checklist.
alex_chan: Agreed. I'll file the postmortem and action item to add an automated alert if fallback_ttl=0 during rotations.
sam_support: Thanks team — customer back in, they cleared device cookie and re-enrolled, confirmed web works now :thumbsup:
jenna_sre: Closing loop once we have PM/Infra signoff for checklist update.
